note: Literature confirms RNU2-2 causes both dominant and recessive neurodevelopmental disorders/DEE with variable seizure penetrance across dominant and biallelic cohorts.

evidence.text: RNU2-2 variants cause neurodevelopmental disorders via both dominant pathogenic variants (35 individuals) and biallelic variants (91 affected individuals across 73 families), sharing overlapping clinical features with frequent epilepsy and variable penetrance/severity across inheritance modes.

source.title: Systematic analysis of snRNA genes reveals frequent RNU2-2 variants in dominant and recessive developmental and epileptic encephalopathies
source.quote: We report RNU2-2 variants in 141 individuals, including 35 with recurrent dominant pathogenic variants and 91 affected members from 73 families with biallelic variants... Dominant and recessive RNU2-2 NDDs share overlapping clinical features, with frequent epilepsy.

evidence.text: Review of noncoding snRNA Mendelian disorders highlights high-impact variants in RNU2-2 with dominant or recessive inheritance patterns where phenotypic differences and penetrance factors influence seizure presentation.

source.title: Small nuclear RNA genes in Mendelian disorders
